A famous model is asking for a restraining order against Bradley Martyn after she claims the fitness influencer violently put his hands on her during a Halloween party last week.

Noelle Leyva, who boasts hundreds of thousands of followers on social media, wrote in an application for a civil harassment restraining order this week that Martyn hit her across the chest and shoved her to the floor while the two were at a packed get-together on Oct. 29 in Los Angeles.

Martyn, however, is vehemently denying the allegations.

Leyva stated the incident all went down after a girl called her over at the bash to talk with her.

“I realized Mr. Martyn was speaking with her,” Leyva wrote in her filing, which was obtained by the California Post on Friday. “As soon as he saw me, he said, ‘F—k off you stupid wh—e’ and hit me across the chest and pushed me onto the ground.”

She said the altercation did not result in any visible markings on her body, but she claimed she’s now “scared, anxious and fearful for my life.”

Leyva alleged in the document that Martyn, 37, has held a grudge against her for years, stating that after they had a business partnership fail in 2023, he told “friends and acquaintances that he wished me dead for ‘what I did to him.’”

She wrote that that initially she “did not take his threats for my life seriously,” but “after what happened on the 29th, I am scared, anxious and humiliated.”

Several people, including Leyva’s boyfriend Colin Hughes, submitted sworn statements to the court alongside Leyva’s request claiming they personally saw the altercation take place.

“Bradley forcefully shoved Noelle, causing her to fall to the ground on the stairs,” Hughes wrote. “Noelle had not physically provoked Bradley or done anything to warrant such an aggressive response.

“Bradley is approximately 6’3” and weights 260 pounds, while Noelle is approximately 5’4” and weighs 100 pounds. Given the significant difference in their physical size and strength, witnessing Bradley forcefully push Noelle to the ground was extremely alarming and frightening.”

Leyva, 25, is asking the court to order Martyn to stay at least 50 yards away from her, her home, her job and her vehicle. Additionally, she wants a judge to bar Martyn “from vilifying me, directly or through his proxies, on social media for filing this petition and post negative commentary about me, my life and my friends.”

Martyn “has a big presence on social media,” she said. “He has over 4 million followers on Instagram alone.”

But Martyn “categorically disputes Ms. Leyva’s account of what occurred on October 29,” the influencer’s attorney, Charles Lew, said in a statement to The Post on Friday.

“Multiple witnesses who were present will corroborate Mr. Martyn’s account,” Lew said. “This is another ill-advised and duplicitous attempt to extort money from my client, and we will respond accordingly.”

Leyva claimed she met Martyn roughly five years ago, when she was 20 and he was 32.

She stated the two entered into an agreement after he told her he could help her “become more famous and earn a lot more” money.

She said she got out of the deal in 2023, though, and Martyn later sued her over her exit, but he “inexplicably dismissed the case” in May 2023.

Additional reporting by Lucas Widman
news.content:
پوشش های بیشتری از ما را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. یک مدل معروف پس از اینکه ادعا کرد که اینفلوئنسر تناسب اندام هفته گذشته در یک مهمانی هالووین به خشونت دست هایش را روی او گذاشته است، درخواست منع ممنوعیتی علیه بردلی مارتین می کند. نوئل لیوا که صدها هزار دنبال کننده در رسانه های اجتماعی دارد، این هفته در درخواستی برای منع آزار و اذیت مدنی نوشت که مارتین در حالی که آن دو در یک گردهمایی پرجمعیت در 29 اکتبر در لس آنجلس بودند، به سینه او ضربه زد و او را به زمین هل داد. دختری او را در باش صدا زد تا با او صحبت کند. لیوا در پرونده خود که روز جمعه در اختیار کالیفرنیا پست قرار گرفت، نوشت: "من متوجه شدم که آقای مارتین با او صحبت می کند." به محض اینکه من را دید، گفت: "ف-خوو احمق" و به سینه ام زد و روی زمین هلم داد.
او گفت که این مشاجره هیچ علامت قابل مشاهده ای روی بدنش نداشت، اما او ادعا کرد که اکنون "ترس، مضطرب و ترسناک برای زندگی من است." لیوا در این سند مدعی شد که مارتین، 37 ساله، سال ها از او کینه ورزی داشته است، و اظهار داشت که پس از شکست شراکت تجاری آنها در سال 2023، او به "دوستان و آشنایانش گفت که آرزوی مرگ من برای "کاری که با او کردم" داشت.
او نوشت که در ابتدا «تهدیدهای او را برای جانم جدی نگرفته است»، اما «پس از اتفاقی که در 29 رخ داد، من ترسیده، مضطرب و تحقیر شده‌ام».

Uberviolent Alan Ritchson action vehicle Motor City (now on AMC+) opens with a very Quentin Tarantinoesque font on the title card, then proceeds to be very UN-Tarantinoesque as it plays out with almost no dialogue. What Motor City director Potsy Ponciroli aims for is the classic Tarantino regurgitated pulp, funneled through the working-class dinge of 1970s Detroit and a thematically curated selection of era-specific songs on the soundtrack. And the result is an entertaining, somewhat experimental riff on revenge-story tropes.

The Gist: This is a revenge story within a revenge story, as one man seeks revenge on another man for stealing his girl, then the second man seeks revenge on the first man after he steals her back. The girl doesn’t seem to have much agency here, but that’s kinda the way movies in the ’70s worked, and this movie wants to be one of those movies, so it’s up to you if you want to accept that excuse. Anyway. You’ve already notched that there’s almost no dialogue here, which means character names are a challenge to glean. The credits reveal them but I’d already dubbed them like so: the Put-Upon Man (Ritchson of Reacher fame), the Girl (Shailene Woodley), the Sleazemeister General (Ben Foster), the Good Cop (Ben McKenzie), and the Bad Cop (Pablo Schreiber). Stereotypes of the genre, for sure.

The other character is a narrator who doesn’t speak, but feeds dimes into the jukebox, shaping the story with Bowie, Fleetwood Mac, the Moody Blues and real cool shit like Bill Withers and Foxy. Drop into the lyrics and you may find some nuance to the story, which otherwise plays out in broad strokes in 1970s Detroit as the Put-Upon Man is framed by the Bad Cop, who’s on the Sleazemeister General’s payroll. Why frame the guy? The Put-Upon Man ended up with the Girl, who used to be the Sleazemeister General’s abusee. Meanwhile, the Good Cop noses around, suspicious of the Bad Cop’s actions. And everything is authentically cigarettes. Everything! CIGARETTES!

The fact that the Put-Upon Man is built like the proverbial shick brithouse doesn’t scare the Sleazemeister General, who’s a rich-as-hell Dee-troit drug lord. But the Sleazemeister doesn’t realize his new enemy is a former Army Ranger — it’s always OPS guys in these movies, black OPS, special OPS, classified OPS, all the OPS OPS OPS — who apparently learned how to endure enormous amounts of pain and shrug off the psychological trauma inherent in murdering people. Car chases, gunfights, fistfights, knife fights, prison breaks, etc., ensue as the righteous face off against the wicked, as the movie gods intended.

What Movies Will It Remind You Of? This is Martin Scorsese’s Rambo funneled through some modern Wick-core aesthetics.

Performance Worth Watching: Well, nobody can eat scenery without dialogue. So the movie inherently sides with Ritchson’s strong, silent type while making Foster’s wordless emoting — even his sweat seems to be sweating — look extra pathetic. The latter is fun to watch.

Sex And Skin: Topless Woodley.

Our Take: Motor City’s emphasis on style over all else means it isn’t the most emotionally engaging story. But it is enjoyable, less experimental than it is a dalliance, Ponciroli toying with form for his and our entertainment, less so as artistic exploration. The amalgamation of needle drops and pantomime is fun and clever, although all creatives involved clearly understand that, even in movies with dialogue, violence is always the loudest language that’s “spoken.” Action speaks louder, and all that.

Enjoyable as it can be, the film clearly hopes our brains brown out as soon as Ritchson tosses a body off a building on top of a massive Big Three sedan in the opening sequence. It breezes right through glaring plot holes, and the Put-Upon Man’s autoworker gig – he wears an actual blue collar at one point – is about as truly, deeply Detroit as the movie ever gets (it was reportedly filmed in New Jersey and Saudi Arabia). The obviously fake streets outside the Fox Theatre are filled with generic scum from the Taxi Driver garage sale, and the soundtrack, so central to the narrative, outright ignores the Stooges, Motown and Alice Cooper. A Jack White cameo only goes so far; one fetishy ogling shot of a ’73 Chrysler Imperial LeBaron would’ve gone over smashingly.

Call it thematic sloppiness or a case of false advertising if you want, but Motor City is otherwise admirable in its attempt to deliver familiarities via a reasonably fresh method. It delivers OTT violence via stylegasm through the gauze of sewer-grate steam and Pall Mall smoke, and eschews dialogue in order to provoke our other senses – we can almost smell Foster’s surely rancid B.O. as the soundtrack thumps, and forces Ponciroli to engage with visual storytelling. At least that stuff is more authentic than the setting.

Our Call: Bottom line? Fun enough. STREAM IT.

John Serba is a freelance film critic from Grand Rapids, Michigan. Werner Herzog hugged him once.

The Gist: این یک داستان انتقامی در یک داستان انتقامی است، زیرا یک مرد به دنبال انتقام از مرد دیگری به دلیل دزدیدن دخترش است، سپس مرد دوم پس از دزدیدن مرد اول به دنبال انتقام از مرد اول است. به نظر می رسد که دختر در اینجا عاملیت چندانی ندارد، اما به نوعی فیلم های دهه 70 کار می کردند، و این فیلم می خواهد یکی از آن فیلم ها باشد، بنابراین اگر می خواهید این بهانه را بپذیرید به شما بستگی دارد. به هر حال. شما قبلاً متوجه شده اید که تقریباً هیچ دیالوگی در اینجا وجود ندارد، به این معنی که نام شخصیت ها چالشی برای جمع آوری است. تیتراژ آن‌ها را آشکار می‌کند، اما من قبلاً آن‌ها را این‌طور دوبله کرده بودم: مرد قرار داده (شهرت ریچر)، دختر (شالین وودلی)، ژنرال اسلیزمایستر (بن فاستر)، پلیس خوب (بن مک‌کنزی)، و پلیس بد (پابلو شرایبر). کلیشه های ژانر، مطمئنا. شخصیت دیگر یک راوی است که صحبت نمی‌کند، اما به جوک باکس پول می‌دهد و داستان را با بووی، فلی، شکل می‌دهد.

Can’t stop checking yourself out in that little box at the bottom of your Zoom screen? The habit may be doing more than simply stealing your attention.

Research suggests that seeing your own face during video calls can trigger physical and mental effects that could sabotage your performance at work.

The good news? You may not be able to escape those virtual meetings that should’ve been emails, but a simple screen adjustment could make them easier to get through.

In a 2024 study, researchers at the University of Galway recruited 32 volunteers — 16 men and 16 women — to take part in a live Zoom meeting.

Before the call, researchers attached electrodes to participants’ scalps to perform an electroencephalogram, or EEG, a painless, noninvasive test that measures the brain’s electrical activity.

During the conference, the volunteers were periodically asked to switch their self-view on and off.

The researchers found that when participants could see themselves on screen, their brains showed significantly greater signs of fatigue than when their self-view was switched off.

The research backs up what workers have been saying for years: Video meetings can leave you feeling mentally and physically drained, even when you’re just sitting at your desk.

The phenomenon, commonly known as “Zoom fatigue,” is believed to have several causes.

One is what’s known as the “mirror effect.” The theory suggests that constantly watching your own face can put you in an unnatural state of heightened self-awareness, forcing you to focus on how you look and behave rather than simply paying attention to the conversation.

Video calls also force our brains to work overtime, juggling what’s being said while trying to read facial expressions, body language and other social cues that come much more naturally during face-to-face conversations.

And those close-up faces staring back at you from the screen may add to the strain, putting your body on high alert and leaving you feeling wiped out.

The research comes years after the COVID-19 pandemic triggered an explosion in remote work, as staffers and students were forced to swap offices and classrooms for computer screens.

“They continue to be heavily used in work and education today and offer some advantages over in-person meetings, but people often report feeling exhausted by video conference meetings,” Eoin Whelan, a professor in the School of Business and Economics at the University of Galway who led the study, said in a press release.

“Our study shows that those feelings of fatigue you get during video calls are real, and seeing your own reflection makes it even more tiring.”

The study also found that men and women appeared to be affected in much the same way.

Previous research, largely based on people’s own accounts through surveys and interviews, had suggested that women experience greater video-call fatigue than men.

The thinking has been that women may be more self-conscious about their appearance when confronted with their own reflection, making it harder to relax and focus during a video call.

But the brain-wave readings told a different story.

“Alpha activity did not change significantly across a 20-minute session, and was not significantly different for men or women,” the study authors wrote.

“Thus, our study does not replicate previous findings that women experience greater video conferencing fatigue because of the increased self-awareness generated when viewing themselves on a screen.”

Fortunately, Whelan said there’s an easy way to ease some of the strain next time you’re on a Zoom call.

“Simply turning off the mirror image can help offset fatigue in virtual meetings,” he advised.
news.content: پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. آیا نمی توانید از بررسی خود در آن کادر کوچک در پایین صفحه زوم خودداری کنید؟ این عادت ممکن است چیزی بیش از دزدیدن توجه شما باشد. تحقیقات نشان می‌دهد که دیدن چهره خود در طول تماس‌های ویدیویی می‌تواند باعث ایجاد اثرات فیزیکی و ذهنی شود که می‌تواند عملکرد شما را در محل کار خراب کند. خبر خوب؟ ممکن است نتوانید از آن جلسات مجازی که باید ایمیل می‌شد فرار کنید، اما یک تنظیم ساده صفحه می‌تواند گذر از آن‌ها را آسان‌تر کند. در مطالعه‌ای در سال 2024، محققان دانشگاه گالوی 32 داوطلب - 16 مرد و 16 زن - را برای شرکت در یک جلسه زوم زنده استخدام کردند. قبل از تماس، محققان الکترودهایی را به پوست سر شرکت‌کنندگان وصل کردند تا الکتروانسفالوگرام یا EEG، یک آزمایش بدون درد و غیرتهاجمی که فعالیت الکتریکی مغز را اندازه‌گیری می‌کند، انجام دهند. در طول کنفرانس، از داوطلبان خواسته شد تا دید خود را روشن و خاموش کنند. محققان دریافتند که وقتی شرکت‌کنندگان می‌توانند خود را روی صفحه ببینند، مغزشان به‌طور قابل‌توجهی نشانه‌های خستگی بیشتری نسبت به زمانی که دید خود را خاموش می‌کرد نشان می‌دهد. این تحقیق از آنچه کارگران سال‌ها گفته‌اند حمایت می‌کند: جلسات ویدیویی می‌توانند احساس خستگی ذهنی و فیزیکی را در شما ایجاد کنند، حتی زمانی که فقط پشت میز خود می‌نشینید. یکی از آنها چیزی است که به عنوان "اثر آینه" شناخته می شود. این تئوری نشان می دهد که به طور مداوم مراقب ow خود هستید

The Democratic Socialists of America notched historic victories on Tuesday, sending a new wave of left-wing lawmakers to Congress and raising eyebrows over their past statements.

At least six more DSA-backed candidates won House races, including New Yorkers Darializa Avila Chevalier and Claire Valdez, Melat Kiros in Colorado, Donavan McKinney in Michigan, Angela Gonzales-Torres in California and Chris Rabb in Pennsylvania.

They’ll join a growing bloc of DSA-aligned pols, including Reps. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez (D-NY), Ilhan Omar (D-Minn.) and Rashida Tlaib (D-Mich.), who have pushed the party to embrace more aggressive positions on immigration, policing, foreign policy and green energy.

The incoming freshman lawmakers have campaigned on everything from universal health care and affordable housing to abolishing Immigration and Customs Enforcement — but their past comments have included calls to abolish police departments, eliminate national borders and radically overhaul America’s economic system.

Here’s a look at some of the DSA candidates’ most head-scratching comments.

Avila Chevalier, who defeated longtime Rep. Adriano Espaillat in New York’s 13th Congressional District, has one of the most extensive histories of controversial social media posts among the incoming lawmakers.

CNN’s KFILE uncovered thousands of now-deleted posts and reports from her former X account, including a response to a user asking what a better slogan would be than “Defund the Police.”

“F you. We’re going to defund and abolish. You don’t get to water down our movements,” she replied.

Other posts called for “no more police at all ever,” abolishing prisons and getting rid of national borders.

She also called for seizing private property and nationalizing major industries, according to CNN’s review of her deleted account.

Her social media presence also includes a 2021 attack on then-Vice President Kamala Harris, who she told to “F—” herself after Harris warned migrants against entering the country from Mexico.

A separate CNN investigation found her old account also repeatedly praised Marxist ideology and communist figures, including Vladimir Lenin. Her account’s biography at one point read, “how communist of you.”

However, Avila Chevalier has now said that she’s “grown considerably” since writing the posts.

New York Assemblywoman Claire Valdez, who won the 7th Congressional District election, also faced criticism over her social media and public comments about Israel.

According to a screenshot obtained by Jewish Insider, Valdez liked an X post published shortly after Hamas’ October 7, 2023, attack on Israel that read: “Glory to the resistance and the people of Palestinian [sic].”

Valdez also sat for an interview with Twitch streamer Lilan Beyer, whose account had previously been suspended after she called Jews a “demonic ethnicity.”

She has also made it clear that she wants to do away with ICE altogether.

“Ultimately it just shouldn’t exist,” Valdez told El País in a September interview when asked about her push to abolish the agency.

Valdez argued that ICE would continue to expand and become more militarized until it was dismantled. Her campaign platform calls for abolishing the agency and replacing the current system with what it describes as humane pathways to citizenship.

Colorado’s Melat Kiros, who defeated longtime Democratic Rep. Diana DeGette in the state’s 1st Congressional District, has been particularly outspoken about America’s immigration and foreign policies.

In a March interview with Colorado Public Radio, Kiros said she wanted to abolish ICE, arguing that the agency was created during an era of fear and Islamophobia following the September 11 attacks.

“We were able to enforce immigration long before the agency existed, and I think we’d be able to do it long after,” she said.

She also claimed that the 9/11 attacks were “inevitable.”

“Inevitable in the sense that we destabilized a lot of the Middle East, which led people to believe that another act of violence was the only response,” Kiros said in a June interview with Denver’s 9News.

She had previously described Hamas’ Oct. 7, 2023, attack on Israel as “an inevitable consequence of apartheid, of occupation, decades of occupation.”

Kiros said her comments were not intended to justify the attacks or diminish their horror, arguing instead that the conditions that lead to violence must be addressed. Her remarks nevertheless drew sharp criticism from her primary opponent, DeGette, who said 9/11 was not inevitable and called the comments shocking and disgusting.

In Pennsylvania, Rabb has offered a rather different take on the criminal justice system — one that includes a carve-out for President Trump’s supporters.

“I’m a decarceration person,” Rabb said during an appearance on Wajahat Ali’s podcast, arguing that the US incarcerates far too many people.

But the Pennsylvania Democrat quickly made an exception.

“It’s also bad policy, but I will make an exception for all of those f—ers who are lawless MAGA thugs, who have destroyed lives and communities. Lock all of those f—ers up,” Rabb said.

He acknowledged the apparent contradiction, calling it “a little hypocritical” to support decarceration while wanting to imprison MAGA supporters.

Rabb, who won the 3rd Congressional District, also found himself in a heated exchange with Fox News host Sean Hannity over his views on policing.

When asked if he wanted to abolish police and prisons during an August appearance on “Hannity,” Rabb argued that most police responsibilities could be handled by other professionals.

“99% of what police do are not going after the bad guys,” Rabb said. “All of that can be done in different ways.”

Rabb argued that public safety should be approached differently, with other trained professionals handling responsibilities that do not require traditional policing.

And in Michigan, McKinney — who defeated Democratic Rep. Shri Thanedar in the primary — offered his own blunt definition of democratic socialism.

“I define politics as the redistribution of resources. That’s it; it’s black and white,” McKinney said in a November interview with Jacobin.

“If you’re in these positions of power and influence, if you’re not trying to figure out ways to bring home as many resources as possible back to your communities and the people you represent, then I need you to get up out of here,” he added.

The Michigan Democrat also argued that money spent on foreign conflicts should instead be directed toward struggling Americans, invoking rapper Tupac Shakur’s lyric: “They got money for wars but can’t feed the poor.”

“You’re telling me we’re spending money for a war that nobody wants — a billion dollars a day in Iran,” McKinney said in the interview, arguing that the money could be used to help people in his district.

Wild footage shows adorable chimpanzees stranded in the historic Florida floodwaters getting fruit and blankets delivered by drone.

One primate at the Save the Chimps sanctuary in Fort Pierce was captured on camera this week happily chowing down on a banana after the flying gadget dropped a paper bag full of grub from above, according to footage from the sanctuary.

Another grinning great ape was shown resting on a drone-delivered blanket as a primate pal picked bugs out of its ear.

Overflowing canal waters have kept staffers at the sprawling, 150-acre sanctuary from reaching parts of the property to feed and care for the animals — after a devastating storm pounded the region with up to 20 inches of rain this week.

“The chimps, who live on islands with care houses at a higher elevation, are safe,” said sanctuary CEO Ana Paula Tavares. “But with flood waters stagnant throughout the property and surrounding area, it has been a major challenge for our staff to arrive at work, much less carry out their responsibilities.”

Other footage shows the primates surrounded by water as staffers try to reach them by boat and truck.

The sanctuary, which is home to 200 rescued chimps,  is normally only accessible by tractor, trailer or large off-road vehicle, according to the sanctuary.

A donated “Swamp Buggy” — designed to navigate marshy terrain — broke down Thursday and other vehicles can’t get through the water, according to a rep for the sanctuary .

A staffer, meanwhile, was hit by more monkey business as he got stuck in a sink hole near the sanctuary on Friday morning, organization said.

Hundreds of Floridians reportedly had to be rescued this week in the Florida storm — which slammed parts of the state with up to 20 inches of rain in just 12 hours, officials said.

پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. فیلم های وحشی نشان می دهد شامپانزه های شایان ستایش در سیل تاریخی فلوریدا در حال تحویل میوه و پتو با پهپاد هستند. یکی از نخستی سانان در پناهگاه Save the Champs در فورت پیرس، این هفته پس از اینکه با خوشحالی یک ابزار پر از کاغذی را در بالای کاغذ می خورد، با خوشحالی از یک کیسه پر از کاغذ در بالای سرش خورده بود. به فیلمی از حرم یکی دیگر از میمون‌های بزرگ خندان نشان داده شد که روی پتویی که توسط هواپیمای بدون سرنشین تحویل داده شده بود، دراز کشیده بود در حالی که رفیق پستانداران حشره‌ها را از گوشش بیرون می‌کشید. آب‌های طغیان‌شده کانال باعث شده کارکنان پناهگاه وسیع 150 هکتاری نتوانند به بخش‌هایی از ملک برای تغذیه و مراقبت از حیوانات برسند - پس از یک طوفان ویرانگر با 2 تا پوند باران. آنا پائولا تاوارس، مدیر عامل پناهگاه گفت: شامپانزه‌ها که در جزایر با خانه‌های مراقبت در ارتفاعات بالاتر زندگی می‌کنند، ایمن هستند. اما از آنجایی که آب های سیل در سراسر ملک و مناطق اطراف راکد است، برای کارکنان ما یک چالش بزرگ برای رسیدن به محل کار بوده است، بسیار کمتر به انجام مسئولیت های خود.
تصاویر دیگر پستانداران را نشان می دهد که توسط آب احاطه شده اند و کارکنان سعی می کنند با قایق و کامیون به آنها برسند. به گفته این پناهگاه، پناهگاهی که 200 شامپانزه نجات یافته را در خود جای داده است، معمولاً فقط با تراکتور، تریلر یا وسیله نقلیه بزرگ خارج از جاده قابل دسترسی است. بنا به گفته یکی از کارشناسان، یک "باگی مرداب" اهدایی - که برای حرکت در زمین های باتلاقی طراحی شده بود - روز پنجشنبه خراب شد و سایر وسایل نقلیه نمی توانند از آب عبور کنند.

Hollywood is putting its employees on notice: Stop betting on Tinseltown’s biggest secrets or risk getting busted.

Major studios and production companies are rolling out strict new rules barring workers from using confidential information to cash in on booming prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket, with at least one company launching an anonymous hotline to snitch on suspected offenders, according to the Hollywood Reporter.

The crackdown comes as the wildly popular betting platforms have opened up a lucrative new way for Hollywood insiders to profit from closely guarded secrets, from major casting announcements to which reality TV contestant gets the boot.

Entertainment companies have begun warning employees that placing wagers on unreleased casting decisions, studio earnings, production schedules and movie release dates is strictly off-limits. Workers are also prohibited from tipping off friends or family members who could place bets on their behalf.

At least one company has gone a step further, establishing a hotline where employees can anonymously report coworkers suspected of gambling on privileged information, the outlet reported.

The sweeping restrictions represent a new frontier in Hollywood’s battle against insider trading, which has traditionally focused on employees illegally profiting from confidential corporate information in the stock market.

But with prediction markets now allowing users to wager on everything from Oscar nominations to reality television eliminations, the potential for abuse has exploded.

“You now have, essentially, an explosion in the number of employers who have to think about insider trading rules from an ethical standpoint,” Columbia University law professor Joshua Mitts told the Hollywood Reporter.

“And totally apart from the question of criminal prosecution, is just the compliance problem — educating your employees on what’s allowed.”

Some Hollywood insiders have already been caught red-handed.

In February, Kalshi revealed that a video editor employed by YouTube superstar MrBeast’s company pocketed $5,000 by improperly wagering on confidential information about the creator’s content. The employee was fired and hit with a whopping $20,000 penalty.

Meanwhile, an April report from Puck exposed a worker connected to a CBS competition series who had allegedly been making money through prediction markets.

The potential for insider betting extends far beyond studio boardrooms.

Television employees, production crews and even audience members attending prerecorded shows could potentially exploit advanced knowledge of what happens on programs like “Saturday Night Live” and “The Tonight Show.”

The frenzy has also reached Hollywood’s biggest casting mysteries.

Betting website BetOnline temporarily suspended wagers this week on who will portray the next James Bond after a sudden flood of money poured in for British actor Callum Turner.

The unexpected surge sent Turner soaring past longtime favorite Jack Lowden, raising concerns that someone might have gotten wind of a closely guarded casting decision.

The site’s representative blamed the suspicious betting activity on “sharp money,” prompting fears of a possible leak.

Prediction markets have also faced scrutiny outside Hollywood.

CNBC reported in July that suspicious wagers tied to US military operations in Venezuela and Iran had raised alarms about potential insider trading.

A former teleprompter operator for President Donald Trump was also suspended amid an investigation into whether he used confidential information to place trades on Kalshi.

Both Kalshi and Polymarket have said they are taking steps to combat insider trading, but catching Hollywood’s would-be betting bandits could prove difficult.

Professor Mitts warned that blockchain-based platforms can allow sophisticated users to conceal their identities through multiple transactions and intermediaries, making suspicious wagers nearly impossible for employers to trace.

Federal regulators are also grappling with which prediction markets should be permitted.

The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has indicated that wagering on awards shows such as the Oscars and Emmys can be allowed, while raising questions about bets involving reality competitions and game shows.

In a bizarre legal twist, federal law already explicitly prohibits futures contracts tied to movie box office receipts, a restriction dating back to the Onion Futures Act of 1958.
news.content: پوشش های بیشتری را در نتایج جستجوی خود مشاهده کنید. هالیوود به کارمندان خود هشدار می دهد: شرط بندی روی بزرگترین اسرار تینسلتاون را متوقف کنید یا در خطر نابودی قرار بگیرید. به گزارش هالیوود ریپورتر، استودیوهای بزرگ و شرکت‌های تولید قوانین جدید سخت‌گیرانه‌ای را وضع می‌کنند که کارگران را از استفاده از اطلاعات محرمانه برای پول نقد در بازارهای پررونق پیش‌بینی مانند Kalshi و Polymarket منع می‌کند، به گفته هالیوود ریپورتر، حداقل یکی از شرکت‌ها خط تلفنی ناشناس راه‌اندازی می‌کند تا از مجرمان مظنون به سرقت ببرد. این سرکوب در حالی صورت می‌گیرد که پلتفرم‌های شرط‌بندی بسیار محبوب، راه سودآور جدیدی را برای خودی‌های هالیوود باز کرده‌اند تا از اسرار کاملا محافظت‌شده سود ببرند، از اطلاعیه‌های بازیگری اصلی که مسابقه‌دهنده تلویزیون واقعیت را دریافت می‌کند. شرکت‌های سرگرمی شروع به هشدار به کارمندان کرده‌اند که شرط‌بندی روی تصمیم‌های بازیگری منتشر نشده، برنامه‌ریزی سخت‌گیرانه استودیویی و کاهش تاریخ تولید فیلم است. کارگران همچنین از دادن خبر به دوستان یا اعضای خانواده خود که می توانند از طرف آنها شرط بندی کنند ممنوع هستند. این رسانه گزارش داد که حداقل یک شرکت یک گام فراتر رفته و خط تلفنی ایجاد کرده است که در آن کارمندان می توانند به طور ناشناس همکاران مشکوک به قمار را بر اساس اطلاعات ممتاز گزارش دهند. محدودیت‌های گسترده نشان‌دهنده مرز جدیدی در نبرد هالیوود علیه تجارت داخلی است، که به طور سنتی بر روی کارمندانی متمرکز شده است که به طور غیرقانونی از اطلاعات محرمانه شرکت در بازار سهام سود می‌برند. اما با پیش‌بینی بازارها اکنون به کاربران اجازه می‌دهد تا روی آنها شرط بندی کنند.

news.originalContent:
Some Republicans are blaming the Trump administration’s attempts to negotiate peace in Iran for the GOP’s bruising midterm defeat Tuesday. One longtime administration official told the Daily Caller, however, that these “establishment ghouls” are really at fault for dragging the country into war in the first place.

Democrats took seven Senate seats and dozens of House seats in the 2026 midterms, flipping both chambers of Congress just two years after President Donald Trump won a decisive presidential election.

Although exit polls suggest the Iran war and the downstream economic consequences motivated Americans to stay home or vote Democrat, some within the GOP have tried to shift the blame to the administration’s memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Iran. (RELATED: JD Vance Carves His Own Path With Blunt Assessment On Disastrous Midterms)

Marc Thiessen, who famously claimed there was “no downside to striking the Iranian regime,” said the Iran war “went really well” and that the peace talks were to blame for the Republicans’ midterm loss.

A longtime administration official rebuked this analysis in a statement to the Caller.

“Warmongering establishment ghouls are the only people disturbed by the thought of peace in the Middle East,” the longtime administration official told the Caller. “It is a fact that the American people supported the MOU.”

“Anyone saying otherwise is carrying water for the Neocon establishment that got us into this mess in the first place,” they continued.

Vice President JD Vance, alongside Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, negotiated an MOU with leaders from both the United States and Iran, which they signed in June.

Although the agreement eventually fell through, some voices on the right claimed Americans soured on the war only after a peace deal was attempted.

“Two Senators tell me the Vice President is right that the GOP turned against the Iran war in the Senate GOP’s own polling,” Erick Erickson said in a post on X. “But they say what the VP leaves out is that the turn came after the VP negotiated a bad deal with the Iranian regime that repulsed the GOP.” (RELATED: White House Sends Mob Boss Message To Conservative Groups After Midterm Blowout)

“The failure wasn’t responding to Iran,” Dana Loesch argued in a similar post. “The failure was refusing to follow through, believing that a murderous mullah regime wants peace, and participating in MOU theater.”

“It wasn’t the Iran war that was the problem on election day,” Thiessen said on Fox News. “It was the Iran MOU.”

Trump’s approval rating has steadily declined since the war, and he himself admitted the negative economic effects were part of the problem.

It’s simply not true that Americans’ problem with the war was the MOU. https://t.co/KorlvxPc1M

The economic consequences of Trump’s joint war with Israel against Iran almost immediately began to tank his approval rating. In contrast, the period when the MOU was being negotiated briefly improved Trump’s approval rating on gas prices and the economy.

A Raymond James study found that Trump’s approval rating was actually correlated to gas prices, not the MOU.

Vance recognized this after the midterm cycle, saying the real reason Republicans lost “is obvious to almost everyone.”

“The reason we lost is the war,” Vance said. “The president himself said so last night.”

The president reiterated this point when he was asked about Vance’s remarks Wednesday afternoon, the day after election night.

“I think it’s largely true because it drove the gas prices up a little bit short term,” Trump said of Vance’s statement. “But at the same time, if I had to do it again, I’d have to do it again.”

news.originalContent:
Data centres face protests across Europe due to the massive amounts of computing power and water they use.

Protesters in the Netherlands have broken into a construction site for a new Microsoft data centre in Amsterdam, the latest action in a growing movement sweeping Europe.

Several hundred activists occupied the site in the Sloterdijk district on Friday, responding to a call for a two-day protest across Europe against data centres, which handle the large processing workloads associated with artificial intelligence (AI). Demonstrators clashed with police as some climbed a crane and set off flares.

Nathan Timmer, of the protest group Geef Tegengas – which translates as Push Back – told local broadcaster AT5 that demonstrators were occupying the site in an effort to stop construction.

“We don’t want it to be built. Nobody needs it,” Timmer said. “The only thing this will be used for is AI slop. AI warfare, data surveillance and committing genocide. We don’t want that.”

Pro-Palestinian activists also joined the demonstrations in the Dutch capital. By late afternoon police were escorting activists off the construction site, though some remained, local media reported.

Dutch police said they detained 150-200 people suspected of trespassing during the protest.

Microsoft said it was aware of the Amsterdam demonstration.

“We understand that people feel strongly about the project, and we respect their right to express those views peacefully,” a spokesperson said. “However, we do not condone any actions that are unlawful or that put people’s safety at risk.”

Data centres face resistance around the world due to the massive amounts of computing power and water they use. Activists argue that the boom in facilities serving cloud computing and AI is moving faster than public consultation and environmental oversight.

Dozens of civil society and grassroots groups have said they will join the “Stop Dirty Data Centres” events on Friday and Saturday in 15 European countries, including Ireland, Poland, Denmark, Finland, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands, France and the United Kingdom, organisers said.

In Germany, a dozen protesters gathered in front of a data centre on the outskirts of Berlin on Friday.

“We want to put a stop to this blind construction of data centres around Germany, regardless of any environmental concerns,” said protest spokeswoman Caro Weber. “This is really, really dangerous for our future.”

About 100 people also protested against data centres in front of the Polish parliament, representing communities around Warsaw where new centres are planned.

In Italy, the fast-growing data centre industry is facing an equally rapid rise in grassroots opposition, particularly in the northern Lombardy region, the country’s main hub for digital infrastructure.

The Issue: Vice President JD Vance blaming the Iran war and US-Israel ties for Republicans’ midterm losses.

Vice President JD Vance is dead wrong (“JD says: Ayatoll-ya so!” Nov. 5).

Republicans lost on Tuesday because President Trump did not emphasize that we are engaging with an enemy who wants us dead via nuclear weapons — and, instead of acknowledging the pain of inflation, continued to repeat silly boasts like “we are the hottest country.”

His important work securing the border, getting tough on crime and keeping men out of women’s sports got lost in the shuffle — a big opportunity now lost.

It didn’t take long for the rats to abandon the ship. The first to jump was Vance. Compare him with Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who maintained a quiet dignity and remained loyal.

Trump demonstrated the courage to prevent Iran from becoming a nuclear-armed power. This came at a cost to Republicans as voters focused on the immediate impact of higher gasoline prices.

If Vance had his way, he likely would’ve preferred to negotiate an Obama-style agreement with Iran.

No one who’s been paying attention to Vance’s ongoing intellectual subservience to Tucker Carlson’s antisemitic isolationism is surprised by him blaming Israel.

Vance couldn’t wait to tell everyone Trump made a mistake with Iran. Wow, would he jump on Trump’s grave that fast?

Now that midterm elections are over and the road to the 2028 election has started, Marco Rubio looks to be best candidate for office.

He has the experience and has shown he can handle foreign countries with dignity and respect. He can lead our country back to where it should be.

I’m curious how much Vance protested as the run up to the war began.

However, he is essentially correct. There was no regime change, and there is no conclusive proof that all nuclear materials were abolished to date. Peace negotiations failed and Iran is still standing.

I believe Trump led this war with Secretary of War Pete Hegseth on a leash, and without critical analysis from military professionals who could assess its potential for success or complications. Remember Colin Powell’s words when he warned about going to war in Iraq: “If you break it, you own it.”

Subscribe to our daily Post Opinion newsletter!

Please provide a valid email.

By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

I wonder how Vance would react if Iran had a nuclear bomb and threatened America or Israel.

Despite his narcissistic tendencies, Trump didn’t act like he wanted to win a popularity contest for his decisions. But neither did President Harry Truman, who ended the war with Japan by using an atomic bomb and later prevented communist North Korea from taking the whole Korean peninsula. He had a low approval rating, too.

Prior to Trump, all Barack Obama and Joe Biden did was funnel a ton of money into Iran. Get real, Vance.

It’s a pity Vance didn’t share his concerns with Trump when basically all could foresee what the consequences would be. However, that would have taken courage, which he obviously lacks.

Vance is a rat abandoning a sinking ship with the hope of salvaging his political future.

JD Vance was virtually unknown when President Trump elevated him to be his vice president. Caesar had his Brutus, and now Trump has his Vance.

As the vice president tries to distance himself from his boss as he looks toward 2028, one of the obvious targets is Israel.

Yet Trump and Benjamin Netanyahu beat him to the punch — as they mutually have agreed to end US financial aid for Israel.

Note that US aid to Israel is about as much as the aid to Egypt and Jordan combined. But Israel shares technology, security and military advancements — whereas Egypt and Jordan return nothing but friendship.

Want to weigh in on today’s stories? Send your thoughts (along with your full name and city of residence) to letters@nypost.com. Letters are subject to editing for clarity, length, accuracy, and style.

news.originalContent:
Credit: Illustration by Daily Caller Staff; with Getty Images (Melissa Sue Gerrits; Mandel NGAN / AFP)

The S&P 500 lost $2.9 trillion in market value after Democrats’ “Blue Tsunami” on Tuesday, marking the largest single-day market-cap decline on record. This is a serious issue for any regular, everyday American worker or retiree with a 401(k) or IRA account. A drop like this will sting badly, especially for those close to retirement.

It’s bad news layered on top of bad election results. One would assume President Donald Trump would offer some uplifting or encouraging words to the downtrodden American people. But that’s not what we got Thursday as the news of the market crash spread. Instead, Trump gleefully blamed the same Americans he knifed in the back.
news.content:
اعتبار: تصویر توسط Daily Caller Staff; با گتی ایماژ (Melissa Sue Gerrits؛ Mandel NGAN / AFP)
S&P 500 پس از «سونامی آبی» دموکرات‌ها در روز سه‌شنبه، ۲.۹ تریلیون دلار از ارزش بازار خود را از دست داد که بزرگترین کاهش یک روزه ارزش بازار را در تاریخ ثبت کرد. این یک مسئله جدی برای هر کارگر یا بازنشسته آمریکایی معمولی و روزمره با حساب 401(k) یا IRA است. قطره ای مانند این به شدت برای کسانی که در آستانه بازنشستگی قرار دارند دردسرساز خواهد شد. این خبر بدی است که در بالای نتایج بد انتخابات قرار دارد. می توان تصور کرد که دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا، سخنان نشاط آور یا تشویق کننده ای به مردم سرکوب شده آمریکا ارائه خواهد کرد. اما این چیزی نیست که روز پنجشنبه با انتشار خبر سقوط بازار دریافت کردیم. در عوض، ترامپ با خوشحالی همان آمریکایی‌هایی را که از پشت با چاقو زد، سرزنش کرد.

news.originalContent:
US authorities found sexually explicit photos that appeared to show Thomas Markle with prepubescent girls.

The estranged father of Britain’s Prince Harry’s wife, Meghan Markle, has been arrested in the United States on a charge of possession of child sexual abuse material.

The US Department of Justice on Friday announced that Thomas Markle Sr was arrested in Florida after law enforcement officers discovered “sexually explicit photographs” of him with prepubescent girls in two storage units, located in the Los Angeles area, that he rented for nearly two decades.

“Mr Markle allegedly targeted innocent children and sought to steal their innocence through his criminal actions”, Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) Director Kash Patel said on Thursday.

According to the Justice Department, authorities learned in October that an individual signed an affidavit stating they had discovered child sex abuse material among Markle’s possessions in the Philippines.

Law enforcement interviewed a separate individual who told them the 82-year-old had rented a storage unit near Los Angeles since 2008. Information gathered from the first individual led to the discovery of a second unit.

After receiving warrants, the Justice Department said FBI agents searched the two units registered to Thomas. Inside, they found 78 items, including photos, film negatives and books that contained explicit imagery of him with underage girls.

The affidavit described three of those photographs. Two showed a man, who a witness identified as Thomas, with a nude prepubescent girl. The third photo shows a nude underage girl in what appeared to be a Philippine hotel room.

Officials, according to the affidavit, also found photos that appeared to show Thomas with “children in various stages of undress”.

Thomas was living in the Philippines earlier this year when he suffered a stroke and had his left leg amputated. That forced him to return to the US.

Meghan issued a statement to The New York Times in October, saying she first learned of the allegations against her father in 2018, when a letter detailing them was sent to the unit of London’s Metropolitan Police that was handling her security then.

“I am deeply distressed at the news that has come to light in the last 24 hours,” the duchess of Sussex wrote to the Times in an apparent reference to reports by the Sun, a British tabloid, on the allegations. “My thoughts are with any children who may have been harmed.”

“I hope it can now be understood that, despite certain media publications’ distortion over the years, any distance from my father and my choice to not allow him to have contact with our children was for one reason: to protect them,” she added.

The arrest of Thomas comes as President Donald Trump’s administration has been criticised for its handling of cases related to the abuse of children, particularly the release of files on the investigation into convicted sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein.

Last year, King Charles stripped Prince Andrew of his princely title as he tried to shield the royal family from the scandal surrounding his brother’s relationship with Epstein.

Meghan, Prince Harry and their two children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, relocated back to the United Kingdom in August.

The Associated Press tried to reach Meghan’s representative on Friday but has not yet heard back.

Thomas Markle is expected to appear in a Florida court on Friday. If convicted, the Justice Department said he could face a maximum sentence of 20 years in a US federal prison.
news.content: مقامات ایالات متحده عکس‌های صریح جنسی را پیدا کردند که به نظر می‌رسید توماس مارکل را با دخترانی در سنین قبل از بلوغ نشان می‌داد. پدر جدا شده همسر شاهزاده هری بریتانیا، مگان مارکل، به اتهام داشتن مواد آزار جنسی از کودکان در ایالات متحده بازداشت شده است. وزارت دادگستری ایالات متحده روز جمعه اعلام کرد که توماس مارکل پدر در فلوریدا دستگیر شد، پس از آن که مأموران اجرای قانون "عکس‌های صریح جنسی" او را با دختران پیش از بلوغ در دو انباری واقع در منطقه لس آنجلس، که برای نزدیک به دو دهه اجاره کرده بود، کشف کردند. کش پاتل، رئیس اداره تحقیقات فدرال (اف‌بی‌آی) روز پنجشنبه گفت: «آقای مارکل ظاهراً کودکان بی‌گناه را هدف قرار داده و با اقدامات جنایتکارانه‌اش به دنبال سرقت بی‌گناهی آن‌ها بوده است. بر اساس گزارش وزارت دادگستری، مقامات در ماه اکتبر دریافتند که فردی سوگندنامه‌ای را امضا کرده است که در آن می‌گوید مواد سوء استفاده جنسی از کودکان را در فیلیپین‌ها کشف کرده‌اند. مجریان قانون با فرد دیگری مصاحبه کردند که به آنها گفت این مرد 82 ساله از سال 2008 یک واحد انباری در نزدیکی لس آنجلس اجاره کرده است. اطلاعات جمع آوری شده از فرد اول منجر به کشف واحد دوم شد. وزارت دادگستری پس از دریافت حکم، گفت که ماموران FBI دو واحد ثبت شده به توماس را جستجو کردند. در داخل آن، 78 آیتم، از جمله عکس، نگاتیو فیلم و کتاب‌هایی که حاوی تصاویر صریح او با دختران زیر سن قانونی بود، پیدا کردند. در سوگندنامه سه مورد از آن عکس‌ها شرح داده شده است. دو نفر الف را نشان دادند

Migrants arrive in Spain’s Canary Islands after being rescued at sea

More than 3,200 migrants were rescued in the first six days of November after crossing the Atlantic from West Africa to Spain’s Canary Islands, one of the world’s deadliest migration routes, putting pressure on reception and emergency services.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Ali Haj Suleiman/Getty Images)

The U.S. military is preparing to establish a presence at an airbase near Damascus to help oversee a potential security agreement between Syria and Israel, Reuters reported Thursday, citing six sources familiar with the plans.

The proposed deployment would place American personnel near Syria’s capital as President Donald Trump pushed for a security arrangement between the two longtime adversaries. However, Syrian officials disputed the reporting, according to the country’s Foreign Ministry.

The facility would sit near portions of southern Syria expected to become a demilitarized zone under a possible nonaggression agreement with Israel, Reuters reported, citing Western and Syrian officials.

The White House did not respond to a request for comment. The Pentagon referred to CENTCOM, which did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

(Photo by Ali Haj Suleiman/Getty Images)

Trump first met Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on May 14, 2025, shortly after announcing plans to lift American sanctions on Syria, according to a White House readout. (RELATED: Trump Moves To Legitimize Ex-Jihadist Leader’s Regime)

During that meeting, Trump urged the Syrian president to join the Abraham Accords with Israel, expel foreign terrorists and help prevent an ISIS resurgence, according to the White House.

The meeting marked a dramatic reversal for al-Sharaa, a former al-Qaeda commander who previously led the Nusra Front, the terrorist network’s Syrian affiliate, before breaking ties with al-Qaeda in 2016 and eventually leading Hay’at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS), according to the Center for Strategic and International Studies.

The State Department subsequently revoked the designation of HTS as a Foreign Terrorist Organization in July 2025, according to the Federal Register.

Trump later hosted al-Sharaa at the White House on Nov. 10, 2025, marking the first such visit by a Syrian president, according to official White House pool reports.

The two leaders met again on July 8, 2026, during the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, where Trump announced plans to remove Syria from Washington’s list of state sponsors of terrorism, according to the State Department.

The Iran war has turned Syria into an alternative oil transportation corridor, allowing Iraq to move petroleum products overland to Mediterranean ports rather than through the Strait of Hormuz, according to the Syrian Petroleum Company.

Iraq initially contracted to transport approximately 650,000 metric tons of fuel oil monthly through Syria from April through June, Reuters reported, citing contracts awarded by Iraq’s state oil marketer SOMO.

By late September, approximately 1,000 to 1,200 tanker trucks carrying Iraqi oil were crossing Syrian territory daily, according to the Syrian Petroleum Company. Syria had also begun moving imported gasoline in the opposite direction, delivering fuel from its Mediterranean coast to Iraq in exchange for transit fees.

The two countries have also agreed to pursue the reconstruction of the Kirkuk-Baniyas oil pipeline, potentially establishing a much larger export route between Iraq and the Mediterranean. The project would involve American energy company Chevron and other international firms, according to Syria’s state-run SANA.

The Pentagon had accelerated preparations for the potential military presence during the preceding two months, conducting multiple reconnaissance missions to determine whether the installation could accommodate American aircraft, Reuters reported, citing a Western military official.

American C-130 military transport aircraft had already landed at the facility to assess runway conditions, while preliminary evaluations suggested the runway was ready for immediate use, Reuters reported, citing Syrian and Western officials.

The proposed mission would involve logistics, surveillance, aircraft refueling and humanitarian operations, according to two Syrian military sources cited by Reuters.

Syria would retain sovereignty over the installation, meaning American personnel would operate there without Washington assuming formal control of the facility, the sources told Reuters.

However, Damascus rejected the report following its publication. (RELATED: Dollar Signs Flash In Eyes Of Ex-Jihadist Leader’s Regime As Iran War Forces Oil To Be Shipped By Land)

Claims about American military bases in Syria were “untrue,” an unidentified Syrian Foreign Ministry official said, according to the state-run Syrian Arab News Agency.

The official nevertheless acknowledged that Damascus and Washington were expanding political, military and economic cooperation, while emphasizing Syria’s sovereignty, according to the Foreign Ministry.

The Pentagon did not confirm the reported deployment, while an administration official declined to discuss specific military locations, Reuters reported.

The Trump administration initially hoped to announce an agreement during September’s United Nations General Assembly, but negotiations encountered last-minute complications, Reuters reported.

Washington was also pressuring Damascus to reach an agreement before the end of 2025, potentially ahead of the Syrian president’s visit to Washington, Reuters reported, citing a Syrian source.

(Photo by Ali Haj Suleiman/Getty Images)

U.S. Central Command Commander Adm. Brad Cooper and American envoy Thomas Barrack met with al-Sharaa in Damascus on Sept. 12 to discuss counterterrorism cooperation and regional stability, according to CENTCOM.

The discussions included combating ISIS and integrating Syrian armed factions into the country’s military, although the American military’s public statement did not mention Israel, CENTCOM said.

The potential Damascus deployment would also represent a departure from America’s established military mission in northeastern Syria.

The Pentagon announced in April that it would reduce American troop levels in Syria to fewer than 1,000 personnel, citing progress against ISIS and a broader consolidation of its regional footprint, according to the Department of War.

Washington has maintained troops in Syria for years as part of operations against ISIS, including cooperation with Kurdish-led forces, according to Reuters.

The United Nations already maintains a peacekeeping mission along the Israeli-Syrian frontier under a disengagement agreement dating to 1974, according to UN Peacekeeping.

It remained unclear how many American troops would deploy, when they would arrive or whether the proposed arrangement would require a permanent U.S. presence, according to Reuters.

Editor’s note: This article has been updated to reflect the Pentagon’s referral to CENTCOM.
news.content:
(عکس از علی حاج سلیمان/گتی ایماژ)
رویترز روز پنجشنبه به نقل از شش منبع آگاه گزارش داد، ارتش ایالات متحده در حال آماده شدن برای حضور در یک پایگاه هوایی در نزدیکی دمشق برای کمک به نظارت بر توافق امنیتی احتمالی بین سوریه و اسرائیل است. استقرار پیشنهادی پرسنل آمریکایی را در نزدیکی پایتخت سوریه قرار می دهد زیرا رئیس جمهور دونالد ترامپ برای یک توافق امنیتی بین دو دشمن دیرینه تلاش می کند. با این حال، به گفته وزارت خارجه این کشور، مقامات سوری این گزارش را رد کردند. رویترز به نقل از مقامات غربی و سوری گزارش داد که این تأسیسات در نزدیکی بخش‌هایی از جنوب سوریه قرار خواهد گرفت که انتظار می‌رود تحت توافق احتمالی عدم تجاوز با اسرائیل به منطقه غیرنظامی تبدیل شود. کاخ سفید به درخواست برای اظهارنظر پاسخی نداد. پنتاگون به CENTCOM اشاره کرد که بلافاصله به درخواست اظهارنظر پاسخ نداد. (عکس از علی حاج سلیمان/گتی ایماژ)
بر اساس قرائت کاخ سفید، ترامپ اولین بار در 14 مه 2025، بلافاصله پس از اعلام برنامه‌های خود برای لغو تحریم‌های آمریکا علیه سوریه، با احمد الشراع، رئیس‌جمهور سوریه در ریاض، عربستان سعودی دیدار کرد. (مرتبط: حرکت ترامپ برای مشروعیت بخشیدن به رژیم رهبر سابق جهادی) به گفته کاخ سفید، ترامپ در آن دیدار از رئیس جمهور سوریه خواست تا به توافق ابراهیم با اسرائیل بپیوندد، تروریست های خارجی را اخراج کند و به جلوگیری از ظهور مجدد داعش کمک کند. این دیدار برای الشراع، فرمانده سابق القاعده که پیش از این رهبری النصره را رهبری می کرد، تغییر چشمگیری داشت.

news.originalContent:
The 71-year-old pontiff is visiting three countries despite undergoing surgery to remove a tumour last month.

Pope Leo XIV has arrived in Uruguay as he begins a 12-day tour of South America, three weeks after undergoing lung cancer surgery that had put the entire trip into question.

The 71-year-old head of the Roman Catholic Church touched down in Montevideo on Friday after a 13-hour flight from Rome, telling reporters he feels “fairly good”.

“I know some people were doubtful about this trip taking place,” Leo told reporters on board the papal plane. “I had no doubt and was convinced that this trip had to go forward. And I am very happy to say praise the Lord and thanks to wonderful medical assistance, I’m here today, I think in fairly good shape.”

On his trip, the pope is scheduled to visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru in one of the most intense papal foreign trips in decades.

His packed three-day itinerary in Uruguay – the region’s least Catholic and most secular country – will include a visit to a neighbourhood with heavy gang violence, a mass in Paysandu, about 375 kilometres (230 miles) from Montevideo, and another mass in the city of Florida, about 100 kilometres (60 miles) from the capital.

Cardinal Daniel Sturla, archbishop of Montevideo, told the AFP news agency that there was “widespread interest in the pope’s visit that goes well beyond the confines of the Catholic Church”, with tickets for masses in Paysandu and Florida quickly running out.

The regional trip is somewhat of a homecoming journey for Leo, as he will finish in Peru in three weeks, where he served for almost two decades as a missionary, forming a deep attachment to the continent.

The trip will take the pope to the former Inca capital of Cusco and the Amazon rainforest, and he will also revisit his old diocese of Chiclayo for a private visit to a chapel he helped rebuild.

Leo said on Wednesday that he was looking forward to returning to a region “so dear to me”.

The leader of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics said he hoped the trip would “strengthen faith, renew hope, and rekindle the fire of charity” in the countries he is visiting, which face rising inequality and violence, as well as a decline in Catholic followers.

Despite undergoing an operation on October 13 to remove a cancerous tumour, doctors have given him the all-clear to travel, and the Vatican said no special medical measures were necessary beyond the standard care on papal trips.

“His stamina is fantastic. The way that he’s singing is incredible. And you can only sing if your lungs are really strong,” said Maria Montserrat Alvarado, the Vatican’s new communications chief. She noted that Leo had passed the 14-day convalescence period required by doctors after his surgery and was eager to get on the road.
news.content:
پاپ 71 ساله علیرغم انجام عمل جراحی برای برداشتن تومور در ماه گذشته، از سه کشور بازدید می کند. پاپ لئو چهاردهم در حالی که تور 12 روزه خود را در آمریکای جنوبی آغاز می کند، سه هفته پس از انجام عمل جراحی سرطان ریه که کل سفر را زیر سوال برده بود، وارد اروگوئه شد. رئیس 71 ساله کلیسای کاتولیک رومی پس از سقوط یک کلیسای کاتولیک رومی در جمعه3-1-3 به پایین رسید. به خبرنگاران گفت که احساس «نسبتاً خوب» دارد. لئو به خبرنگاران حاضر در هواپیمای پاپ گفت: «می‌دانم که برخی از مردم درباره انجام این سفر تردید داشتند. "من شکی نداشتم و متقاعد شدم که این سفر باید ادامه یابد. و بسیار خوشحالم که خداوند را ستایش می کنم و با تشکر از کمک های پزشکی فوق العاده، امروز اینجا هستم، فکر می کنم در وضعیت نسبتا خوبی هستم."
پاپ در سفر خود قرار است از اروگوئه، آرژانتین و پرو در یکی از شدیدترین سفرهای خارجی پاپ در چند دهه اخیر بازدید کند. سفر سه روزه او در اروگوئه - کمترین کاتولیک‌ترین و سکولارترین کشور منطقه - شامل بازدید از محله‌ای با خشونت‌های شدید گروه‌های تبهکار، مراسم توده‌ای در پایساندو، در حدود 375 کیلومتری (230 مایلی) از مونته ویدئو، و توده‌ای دیگر در شهر فلوریدا، در حدود 100 کیلومتری (60 مایلی) از پایتخت خواهد بود. کاردینال دانیل استورلا، اسقف اعظم مونته ویدئو، به خبرگزاری فرانسه گفت که "علاقه گسترده ای به دیدار پاپ وجود دارد که فراتر از محدوده کلیسای کاتولیک است" و بلیط های توده های مردمی در پایساندو و فلوریدا به سرعت تمام شد. سفر منطقه ای به پایان رسید.

news.originalContent:
(Photo by Alex Wong/Getty Images)

President Donald Trump has tapped top immigration adviser Stephen Miller as White House chief of staff.

Trump’s announcement came just three days after Republicans suffered losses in the midterm elections Tuesday night, resulting in the party losing control of both chambers of Congress.

In a post on Truth Social Friday, the president announced that Miller will fill the position starting Monday and thanked current Chief of Staff Susie Wiles. (RELATED: Trump Denies Reports That He Was Considering Firing Susie Wiles)

“I am pleased to announce that Mr. Stephen Miller, the current Deputy Chief of Staff of the Trump Administration, and one of my most trusted advisors, will become the Chief of Staff starting Monday, November 9, 2026. Susie Wiles, who has done an outstanding job, will be moving over to the Trump Political Operation. I want to thank her for her service as Chief of Staff — She has done a great job!” the president wrote.

Following Trump’s announcement, Wiles confirmed in a statement posted to X that Friday would be her final day serving as White House chief of staff.

The Daily Caller can confirm that Wiles gave the President her resignation on Thursday night.

“Serving President Trump in the White House has been the honor of a lifetime. I’m so proud to have been a part of what we’ve accomplished together from securing our border and cutting taxes to strengthening our economy and putting America First,” Wiles said.

Today is my last day as White House Chief of Staff. Serving President Trump in the White House has been the honor of a lifetime. I’m so proud to have been a part of what we’ve accomplished together from securing our border and cutting taxes to strengthening our economy and putting America First. More than anything, I’m grateful for the extraordinary people I’ve had the privilege of working alongside. While my role may be changing, my commitment to the President and the mission never will.

She added that she was grateful for the people she had worked alongside, emphasizing that while her role was changing, her commitment to Trump and his agenda would remain.

“More than anything, I’m grateful for the extraordinary people I’ve had the privilege of working alongside. While my role may be changing, my commitment to the President and the mission never will,” she added.

When asked about Trump’s announcement that Miller would replace Wiles, a former administration official told the Caller that Miller’s approach to immigration policy was focused on accomplishing policy goals rather than seeking publicity.

“He genuinely cares about accomplishing the policy goal. Not making a big fat show on Fox News like Kristi did,” the former official said, referring to former Department of Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem.

The former official also said Miller “hated the Kristi theatrics,” predicting that he would be “getting dragged into that but that’s never what he wanted.” The official added that, if it had been up to Miller, mass deportations would have been carried out “with no one knowing it was happening.”

Miller has served as White House deputy chief of staff for policy and homeland security adviser since the start of Trump’s second administration in January 2025.

In that role, he was a senior policy aide with major influence over immigration, border enforcement, domestic policy coordination, and broader executive actions.

He previously worked as a senior advisor and speechwriter in Trump’s first term, with a heavy focus on immigration policy.
news.content:
(عکس از الکس وانگ/گتی ایماژ)
دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور آمریکا، استیون میلر، مشاور ارشد مهاجرتی را به عنوان رئیس دفتر کاخ سفید انتخاب کرده است. اعلام ترامپ تنها سه روز پس از شکست جمهوری خواهان در انتخابات میان دوره ای سه شنبه شب بود که منجر به از دست دادن کنترل هر دو اتاق کنگره توسط حزب شد. رئیس جمهور در پستی در Truth Social Friday اعلام کرد که میلر از روز دوشنبه این سمت را پر خواهد کرد و از سوزی وایلز رئیس فعلی ستاد تشکر کرد. (مرتبط: ترامپ گزارش‌هایی مبنی بر اینکه در نظر داشت سوزی وایلز را اخراج کند را تکذیب کرد)
«خوشحالم که اعلام کنم که آقای استفان میلر، معاون فعلی رئیس ستاد دولت ترامپ و یکی از مورد اعتمادترین مشاوران من، از دوشنبه 9 نوامبر 2026 رئیس ستاد خواهد شد. سوزی وایلز، که کار برجسته ای انجام داده است، به عملیات سیاسی ترامپ منتقل خواهد شد. من می خواهم از او به خاطر خدماتش به عنوان رئیس ستاد تشکر کنم - او کار بزرگی انجام داده است!» رئیس جمهور نوشت. پس از اعلام ترامپ، وایلز در بیانیه ای که برای X ارسال شد تأیید کرد که جمعه آخرین روز خدمت او به عنوان رئیس دفتر کاخ سفید خواهد بود. Daily Caller می تواند تأیید کند که وایلز پنجشنبه شب استعفای خود را به رئیس جمهور داده است. وایلز گفت: "خدمت به رئیس جمهور ترامپ در کاخ سفید افتخار یک عمر بوده است. من بسیار مفتخرم که بخشی از آنچه با هم از امنیت مرزها و کاهش مالیات ها گرفته تا تقویت اقتصاد و اولویت دادن به آمریکا انجام داده ایم."

او در نخستین گفت‌وگوی کارشناسان نشست «شانگهای پلاس» درباره مسائل امنیتی که در شهر سمرقند ازبکستان برگزار شد، گفت این گروه همچنان از هوش مصنوعی استفاده می‌کند و این موضوع در محتوای تبلیغاتی آن که به زبان‌های آسیای میانه منتشر می‌شود، بازتاب یافته است.

این مقام سازمان ملل متحد گفته است: سایر گروه‌های تروریستی فعال در سطح منطقه‌ای و ملی نیز از چنین روش‌هایی بهره می‌برند.

الکساندر زویف افزود: «همان‌طور که در سخنرانی خود تأکید کردم، آسیای میانه به‌طور سنتی از اشکال مختلف تروریسم رنج برده است و ازبکستان نیز از این قاعده مستثنی نیست.»

به گفته او: «اکنون وضعیت تازه‌ای پیدا شده است، زیرا با گسترش اینترنت، سربازگیری مجازی و ارتباطات آنلاین گروه‌های تروریستی، آسیای میانه در برابر تهدیدهای تروریستی گوناگون آسیب‌پذیرتر شده است.»

او افزود: «به همین دلیل، ما به دنبال راه‌هایی هستیم تا از حملات تروریستی پیش از وقوع جلوگیری کنیم، نه اینکه تنها پس از وقوع آن‌ها واکنش نشان دهیم.»

از سوی دیگر، بهادر قربانف، رئیس اداره امنیت ملی (استخبارات) ازبکستان، در این نشست ضمن اشاره به خطرات هوش مصنوعی، بر ظرفیت‌های این فناوری برای مقابله با تهدیدات امنیتی نیز تأکید کرد.

او به عنوان نمونه گفت که هوش مصنوعی می‌تواند در شناسایی کارزارهای هماهنگ اطلاعاتی، آشکار کردن نشانه‌های دستکاری و افزایش کارآمدی فعالیت‌های تحلیلی نقش مؤثری ایفا کند.

آقای قربانف همچنین پیشنهاد کرد که برای مقابله با «تروریسم سایبری»، یک پلتفرم بین‌المللی همکاری‌های فنی ایجاد شود.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

عبدالحق وثیق، رئیس استخبارات طالبان، که در این نشست به نمایندگی از حکومت طالبان شرکت کرده بود، گفت: «در دوران کنونی هوش مصنوعی، ما نگرانیم که عناصر ضد امنیتی، به‌ویژه داعش که برای تمام جهان یک تهدید است، با استفاده از آن، ساخت مواد سمی و برخی قطعات سلاح‌های مرگبار را بیاموزند و اقداماتی انجام دهند که محدودیت‌های وضع‌شده در زمینه استفاده از هوش مصنوعی را دور بزنند.»

او افزود: «امارت اسلامی افغانستان که در حال حاضر بر اساس فکر و عقیده خود در خط مقدم مبارزه با داعش قرار دارد، در زمینه از بین بردن امکانات تکنیکی یک دشمن جهانی مانند داعش، با محدودیت‌های شدید مواجه است.»

طالبان، حکومت خود را «امارت اسلامی» می‌نامند.

او با انتقاد از عدم همکاری شرکت‌های فناوری مانند تلگرام، تیک‌تاک و دیگر شرکت‌ها، مدعی شد که «داعش از محصولات آن‌ها برای ارتباطات، تامین مالی (تمویل) و انحراف فکری استفاده می‌کند، اما این شرکت‌ها هیچ‌گونه همکاری با افغانستان نمی‌کنند.»

شاخه خراسان داعش در افغانستان فعالیت می‌کند و در سال‌جاری میلادی مسئولیت دست‌کم سه حمله را به عهده گرفته است.

حکومت طالبان می‌گوید که داعش را به شدت سرکوب کرده است.

ازبکستان در روزهای ۵ و ۶ نوامبر میزبان نخستین نشست گفت‌وگوی کارشناسی «شانگهای پلاس» سازمان همکاری شانگهای (SCO) درباره مسائل امنیتی در شهر سمرقند بود.

در این نشست، ۳۳ هیئت از ۲۴ کشور و پنج سازمان بین‌المللی گردهم آمدند تا درباره مبارزه با تروریسم، افراط‌گرایی و تهدیدهای نوظهور امنیتی مرتبط با هوش مصنوعی و تحول دیجیتال گفت‌وگو کنند.

موضوع اصلی این نشست «امنیت در عصر تحول دیجیتال: مقابله با تروریسم و افراط‌گرایی در سایه توسعه فناوری‌های نوین»  بود. شرکت‌کنندگان دیدگاه‌های خود را درباره تأثیر فناوری‌های پیشرفته و هوش مصنوعی بر ماهیت چالش‌ها و تهدیدهای امنیتی کنونی با یکدیگر به اشتراک گذاشتند.

آقای زویف در این نشست تأکید کرد که جوانان، از جمله کودکانی از ۱۰ سال به بالا، همچنان در برابر روش‌های جذب و سربازگیری مبتنی بر هوش مصنوعی آسیب‌پذیر هستند و شواهد و اطلاعات مستندی در تأیید این موضوع وجود دارد.

انتشار گزارش‌ها در مورد حضور گروه‌های تندرو و مسلح در افغانستان یکی از نگرانی‌های اصلی کشورهای منطقه، به‌ویژه کشورهای آسیای میانه، چین و روسیه به شمار می‌رود.

کارشناسان معتقدند که ثبات افغانستان برای امنیت مرزهای جنوبی آسیای مرکزی اهمیت اساسی دارد و هرگونه بی‌ثباتی در این کشور می‌تواند بر امنیت و توسعه در منطقه تأثیر بگذارد.

news.originalContent:
وزارت امور خارجه پاکستان اعلام کرده است که اسلام‌آباد در حال بررسی پیشنهاد دولت ایالات متحده مبنی بر اخراج شهروندان افغانستان از طریق این کشور است.

سجاد حیدر خان، سخنگوی این وزارت، در یک نشست خبری گفت: «این مسئله هم‌اکنون در دست بررسی است و تمام جوانب مرتبط با آن، با مشورت طرف‌های ذی‌نفع، به دقت مورد ارزیابی قرار می‌گیرند.»

آقای خان ابراز امیدواری کرد که دوطرف به راهکاری که مورد توافق طرفین در این زمینه باشد، دست یابند.

رسانه‌های آمریکایی هفته گذشته گزارش داده بودند که بیش از ۱۵۰ افغان در چارچوب تازه‌ترین اقدامات سختگیرانه مهاجرتی دونالد ترامپ، از طریق پاکستان به افغانستان اخراج خواهند شد.

به گفته گروه «افغان‌ایوک» که برای کمک به افغان‌های همکار با آمریکا فعالیت می‌کند، در میان این افراد بستگان افغان‌هایی نیز حضور دارند که پیش از سقوط کابل با ارتش امریکا همکاری کرده بودند.

یک دادگاه فدرال آمریکا روز سه‌شنبه طرح حکومت ترامپ در مورد اخراج ده‌ها مهاجر افغان به افغانستان را متوقف کرد.

والری کاپرونی، قاضی دادگاه منطقه‌ای ایالات متحده در ناحیه جنوبی نیویورک، حکم داد که ایالات متحده نمی‌تواند در جریان این هفته هیچ فرد افغان را به افغانستان یا پاکستان اخراج کند.

مقام‌های حکومت طالبان روز دوشنبه نسبت به گزارش‌ها درباره برنامه اخراج افغان‌ها «نگرانی جدی» ابراز کرده بودند.

گروه‌های مدافع حقوق مهاجران هشدار داده‌اند که بازگرداندن متحدان پیشین آمریکا و اعضای خانواده آن‌ها می‌تواند جان‌شان را به خطر بیندازد.

حکومت طالبان پس از بازگشت به قدرت در سال ۲۰۲۱ عفو عمومی اعلام کرد و گفت افغان‌هایی که با نیروها و دولت‌های مورد حمایت غرب همکاری کرده‌اند، می‌توانند به کشور بازگردند. مقام‌های حکومت طالبان امسال نیز بار دیگر این تعهد را تکرار کرده‌اند.

با این حال، سازمان ملل متحد گزارش‌هایی از قتل‌های فراقضایی، بازداشت‌ها و موارد نقض حقوق بشر را ثبت کرده است.

براساس گزارش‌ها، دولت آمریکا در ماه ژوئن امسال شماری از مهاجران از جمله شهروندان افغانستان و ایران را به جمهوری آفریقای مرکزی اخراج کرد.

دونالد ترامپ سال گذشته در چارچوب سیاست‌های سختگیرانه مهاجرتی خود، محدودیت‌های سفر را برای شماری از کشورها، از جمله افغانستان، وضع کرد.

دولت او همچنین در پی لغو حمایت‌های قانونی در برابر اخراج برای افغان‌ها بود که برخی از آن‌ها پس از تسلط حکومت طالبان بر افغانستان در سال ۲۰۲۱ ویزای ویژه مهاجرتی دریافت کرده بودند.
news.content:
وزارت امور خارجه پاکستان اعلام کرده است که اسلام‌آباد در حال بررسی پیشنهاد دولت ایالات متحده مبنی بر اخراج شهروندان افغانستان از طریق این کشور است.

سجاد حیدر خان، سخنگوی این وزارت، در یک نشست خبری گفت: «این مسئله هم‌اکنون در دست بررسی است و تمام جوانب مرتبط با آن، با مشورت طرف‌های ذی‌نفع، به دقت مورد ارزیابی قرار می‌گیرند.»

آقای خان ابراز امیدواری کرد که دوطرف به راهکاری که مورد توافق طرفین در این زمینه باشد، دست یابند.

رسانه‌های آمریکایی هفته گذشته گزارش داده بودند که بیش از ۱۵۰ افغان در چارچوب تازه‌ترین اقدامات سختگیرانه مهاجرتی دونالد ترامپ، از طریق پاکستان به افغانستان اخراج خواهند شد.

به گفته گروه «افغان‌ایوک» که برای کمک به افغان‌های همکار با آمریکا فعالیت می‌کند، در میان این افراد بستگان افغان‌هایی نیز حضور دارند که پیش از سقوط کابل با ارتش امریکا همکاری کرده بودند.

یک دادگاه فدرال آمریکا روز سه‌شنبه طرح حکومت ترامپ در مورد اخراج ده‌ها مهاجر افغان به افغانستان را متوقف کرد.

والری کاپرونی، قاضی دادگاه منطقه‌ای ایالات متحده در ناحیه جنوبی نیویورک، حکم داد که ایالات متحده نمی‌تواند در جریان این هفته هیچ فرد افغان را به افغانستان یا پاکستان اخراج کند.

مقام‌های حکومت طالبان روز دوشنبه نسبت به گزارش‌ها درباره برنامه اخراج افغان‌ها «نگرانی جدی» ابراز کرده بودند.

گروه‌های مدافع حقوق مهاجران هشدار داده‌اند که بازگرداندن متحدان پیشین آمریکا و اعضای خانواده آن‌ها می‌تواند جان‌شان را به خطر بیندازد.

حکومت طالبان پس از بازگشت به قدرت در سال ۲۰۲۱ عفو عمومی اعلام کرد و گفت افغان‌هایی که با نیروها و دولت‌های مورد حمایت غرب همکاری کرده‌اند، می‌توانند به کشور بازگردند. مقام‌های حکومت طالبان امسال نیز بار دیگر این تعهد را تکرار کرده‌اند.

با این حال، سازمان ملل متحد گزارش‌هایی از قتل‌های فراقضایی، بازداشت‌ها و موارد نقض حقوق بشر را ثبت کرده است.

(Photo by Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images)

Republican Kentucky Sen. Rand Paul has pinned the GOP’s midterm bloodbath on mounting economic pressures facing Americans, including the Iran War.

Paul attributed the GOP’s losses across the country Tuesday night, in part, to voters’ concerns about the cost of living. Paul argued that Republicans need to shift their focus away from foreign wars and trade wars toward economic issues. (RELATED: The Forgotten Lesson Of The McKinley Tariff)

When asked by the Daily Caller about his reflections on the election results, Paul pointed to inflation, the war in Iran, and tariffs as factors adding to the financial pressures facing American families.

Sen. Rand Paul responds to Trump’s tariffs: "When McKinley most famously put tariffs on in 1890, they lost 50% of their seats… In the early 1930s, we lost the house and senate for 60 years. So not only bad economically, they are bad politically." https://t.co/G4QsPX89EA

“All exit polls showed voters were concerned with the high cost of living. Republicans need to understand that inflation from deficit financing eroded paychecks by about 27% over the past 6 years and the Iran war caused gasoline, diesel, and fertilizer prices to soar,” Paul wrote.

He continued, “Tariffs added another cost to consumers. To win back voters, Republicans need to offer balanced budgets and end the Iran War and the Trade wars.”

An NBC News exit poll conducted Tuesday found that 63 percent of voters believed the U.S. made the wrong decision in taking military action against Iran, while 37 percent said it was the right decision.

The findings add context to the economic concerns Paul cited, as higher fuel and fertilizer costs tied to the conflict have put additional pressure on consumers and farmers. Paul also argued tariffs have compounded those costs, making trade and foreign policy central to his assessment of the GOP’s midterm losses. (RELATED: Data Centers Made Noise, But Skyrocketing Gasoline And Diesel Prices Decided The Midterms)

Paul’s observation is echoed in Tuesday’s NBC News exit poll, which found that roughly 65 percent of midterm voters said President Donald Trump’s tariff policies have hurt the national economy, while just 21 percent said they have helped.

A war with Iran would make Iraq look like a skirmish. If your goal were to bankrupt America and destabilize the world, dragging us into another endless Middle East war would be the way to do it. That’s why I’m glad @POTUS promised—and brought the country together—on a commitment to peace, not more war.

Paul has long warned that tariffs could carry significant political consequences for Republicans. In an April 2025 opinion piece, he argued that the policies could hurt both American families and the GOP. “Tariffs are not just bad for American families and the national economy; tariffs are also bad for Republicans,” Paul wrote.

The Kentucky lawmaker has been a vocal opponent of the war in Iran while in Congress. In March of this year, Paul was the only Republican in the Senate who voted to rein in the Trump administration’s efforts in Iran, arguing the military action required congressional authorization.

Our greatest threat isn’t Iran—it’s our exploding national debt. We were never in danger of Iranian troops invading the U.S. This war never should have started, and the sooner it ends, the safer America and our soldiers will be. @Varneyco https://t.co/hyhaTvqiwE

Since then, Paul has remained a critic of the conflict, asserting that continued hostilities would result in a greater financial burden on American families. (RELATED: Canada Hits Back At Trump Tariffs As Trade War Threatens Key Midterm Battlegrounds)

In July, the senator declared the U.S. was “worse off” after the war than before, arguing that restricted oil passage through the Strait of Hormuz left the country in a worse position and that rising costs were weighing on everyday Americans, according to The Hill.

As Republicans assess their midterm losses and consider how to rebuild voter support, Paul’s longstanding calls for free markets, free trade, and a more restrained foreign policy are likely to become part of the broader debate over the party’s direction.

رند پل، سناتور جمهوریخواه کنتاکی، حمام خون میان دوره ای جمهوری خواهان را به فشارهای اقتصادی فزاینده ای که آمریکایی ها با آن روبه رو هستند، از جمله جنگ ایران، مرتبط دانسته است. پل زیان های حزب جمهوری خواه در سراسر کشور سه شنبه شب را تا حدی به نگرانی رای دهندگان در مورد هزینه زندگی نسبت داد. پل استدلال کرد که جمهوری خواهان باید تمرکز خود را از جنگ های خارجی و جنگ های تجاری به سمت مسائل اقتصادی تغییر دهند. (مرتبط: درس فراموش شده تعرفه مک کینلی)
هنگامی که از دیلی کالر در مورد بازتاب خود در مورد نتایج انتخابات پرسیده شد، پل به تورم، جنگ در ایران و تعرفه ها به عنوان عواملی اشاره کرد که بر فشارهای مالی که خانواده های آمریکایی با آن روبه رو هستند می افزاید. رند پل به تعرفه‌های ترامپ پاسخ می‌دهد: «زمانی که مک‌کینلی در سال 1890 تعرفه‌ها را به‌طور معروف اعمال کرد، 50 درصد کرسی‌های خود را از دست دادند... در اوایل دهه 1930، ما مجلس و سنا را برای 60 سال از دست دادیم. بنابراین نه تنها از نظر اقتصادی بد هستند، بلکه از نظر سیاسی نیز بد هستند." https://t.co/G4QsPX89EA
«همه نظرسنجی‌ها نشان داد که رای‌دهندگان نگران هزینه بالای زندگی هستند. جمهوری خواهان باید درک کنند که تورم ناشی از تامین مالی کسری حقوق در 6 سال گذشته حدود 27 درصد کاهش یافت و جنگ ایران باعث افزایش قیمت بنزین، گازوئیل و کود شد. جمهوری خواهان برای به دست آوردن مجدد رای دهندگان باید بودجه های متعادلی ارائه دهند و به جنگ ایران و جنگ تجاری پایان دهند.
یک نظرسنجی خروجی NBC News که روز سه شنبه انجام شد نشان داد که 63 درصد از رای دهندگان به دیوانگی ایالات متحده اعتقاد داشتند.
